title: 1.3 Plate Movements and Plate Boundaries
description: Convergent, divergent and transform boundaries, subduction, seafloor spreading and mantle convection. Medium level.

questions.question: Why is oceanic crust subducted beneath continental crust?
options: Oceanic basalt is denser than continental granite
Continental granite is denser than oceanic basalt
Oceanic crust is thicker and lighter
questions.correctAnswer: Oceanic basalt is denser than continental granite

questions.question: Which mountain range formed as the Nazca Plate subducted beneath the South American Plate?
Which islands formed from the convergence of two oceanic plates?
Which range formed as the Indo-Australian Plate met the Eurasian Plate?
What is seafloor spreading?
options: The creation of new oceanic crust at mid-ocean ridges
The destruction of crust at subduction zones
The sliding of plates past each other
The melting of continental ice sheets
questions.correctAnswer: The creation of new oceanic crust at mid-ocean ridges

questions.question: Where are shallow earthquakes especially common?
What landform forms when continental crust diverges?
Which feature is a modern example of continental divergence?
What happens to crust along a transform fault?
options: It is neither created nor destroyed
questions.correctAnswer: It is neither created nor destroyed

questions.question: What ultimately drives plate motion according to most geoscientists?
options: The gravitational pull of the moon
